question: Which is the native state of Bharat Ratna awardee Bhupen Hazarika?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Bhupen Hazarika is an **Assamese singer-composer.**
 
• Bharat Ratna Awards 2019 was conferred to **Bhupen Hazarika, Nanaji Deshmukh, and Pranab Mukherjee.**
 
• Bhupen Hazarika was born on **September 8, 1926, in Sadiya, Assam, India.**
 
• He received several prestigious awards like the Dadasaheb Phalke Award, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan.</strong&g
